# prime-picklist

prime-rs: PickList component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/picklist) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-picklist) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/picklist.md)

PickList — port of `p-picklist` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Two lists (source and target) with buttons for transferring and reordering. The lists, selection and search are the ready-made
`Listbox`; transfer is pure logic in `transfer`, reordering is `prime_orderlist::reorder`.

```rust
#![recursion_limit = "512"]
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_listbox::ListboxOption;
use prime_picklist::PickList;

let source = RwSignal::new(vec![ListboxOption::new("Apple", "a")]);
let target = RwSignal::new(Vec::<ListboxOption>::new());
let html = view! { <PickList source=source target=target /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-picklist-transfer-controls") && html.contains("Apple"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-picklist = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["picklist"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
